The '''Nightmare Pilgrim''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] who was corrupted by the [[Nightmare Lands]] and became extremely powerful, returning to the nearby [[Gormak Lands]]. He commanded a massive creature known as [[the Thing from the Stars]], which resembled a [[Tarsarian devourer]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nightmare Pilgrim appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where he is the World Boss for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]].<ref name="TOR" /> The Pilgrim and the Thing From the Stars, who can be summoned by clicking a tablet in the Gormak Lands, were added to ''The Old Republic'' in Game Update 1.2: Legacy on [[April 12]], [[2012]].<ref name="1.2">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/1.2.0/legacy|text=Game Update 1.2: Legacy Patch Notes}}</ref>
